Party / encounter niche: A planned group chain or knockback
Skill eligibility in current WS profile: hand to hand, dagger, sword, great sword, axe, great axe, scythe, polearm, club, staff, archery, marksmanship
Target equipment / priorities: WAR open skills. Start with an axe and prioritize accuracy, HP and JA availability.
HUD / resource design: Shared stance, mark and ward expiry
Specific regression: Open at zero TP. Test a chain inside and outside Breach and have an ally stand outside the formation.
Lore basis: Warcry and the Warrior's combat stances

Party / encounter niche: Short physical burn with healing available
Skill eligibility in current WS profile: hand to hand, dagger, sword, great sword, axe, great axe, scythe, polearm, club, staff, archery, marksmanship
Target equipment / priorities: WAR open skills. Prefer great axe, attack, multiattack and accuracy.
HUD / resource design: Surge remaining, recoil and current HP
Specific regression: Record damage, HP recoil and lost swings through a boss retaliation. Check Savage Cleave on a single claimed target.
Lore basis: Warcry and the Warrior's combat stances

Party / encounter niche: A telegraphed heavy hit with a buckler
Target equipment / priorities: Polearm plus the supported buckler path. HP, block, accuracy and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Grit, Brace and Iron Resolve
Specific regression: Pull without /WAR as a dependency, brace before an attack, then repeat with buckler removed. Check ward depletion.
Lore basis: Warcry and the Warrior's combat stances

Party / encounter niche: Repeated parryable or evasible melee
Target equipment / priorities: Staff, evasion, parry, HP and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Stance, recent parry/evade and riposte
Specific regression: Check distinct miss, parry and hit outcomes. On a spell-only target verify that incoming magic cannot manufacture ripostes.
Lore basis: Boost, disciplined weapon choice and martial stances

Party / encounter niche: Allies clustered around an engaged enemy
Target equipment / priorities: Both main and sub empty. H2H is the WS skill. MND, cure potency and accuracy take priority.
HUD / resource design: Boost 0–100, pulse reach, Chi Blast
Specific regression: At 0, partial and 100 Boost compare heal and cleanse. Stand within bolt range with one ally near the target and another outside pulse range. Verify zero MP cost.
Lore basis: Boost, disciplined weapon choice and martial stances

Party / encounter niche: Sustained uninterrupted melee with fast TP recovery
Target equipment / priorities: H2H weapon or bare fists. STR, DEX, kick attacks, attack, accuracy and haste.
HUD / resource design: Boost readiness, TP and stance timers
Specific regression: Log TP before and after a qualifying WS. Verify exactly one +75 refund, including bare fists. Re-equip a staff and check the existing weapon gate.
Lore basis: Boost, disciplined weapon choice and martial stances

Party / encounter niche: One ally about to take a lethal hit
Target equipment / priorities: Club and shield for block, or staff for supported WS. MND, MP, cure potency and cast time.
HUD / resource design: Solace Ward, Grace and Smite return
Specific regression: Repeat the same boss hit with a ward already present and with the cure landed after impact. Track real absorption and overheal.
Lore basis: divine magic, Solace and protection of allies

Signature decision: Earn casting MP with a staff
Party / encounter niche: A long fight with alternating melee and divine-cast windows
Target equipment / priorities: Staff main, grip optional. Accuracy first, then MND, divine skill and MAB.
HUD / resource design: MP, next eligible staff refund and Holy recast.
Specific regression: Record 20s in melee and out of melee. A multiattack earns one refund, a WS earns zero. Compare sustained divine DPS and healing throughput to Bishop.
Lore basis: divine magic, Solace and protection of allies

Party / encounter niche: A vulnerable caster repeatedly interrupted by enemy hits
Target equipment / priorities: Polearm, HP, magic evasion and positioning. No shield required.
HUD / resource design: Wingmate, interrupted spell, retry deadline.
Specific regression: Interrupt Cure with a hit, then cancel it manually. Only the first event arms Escort. A second Valkyrie cannot consume the same interruption.
Lore basis: divine magic, Solace and protection of allies

Party / encounter niche: One brief elemental burst check on an unsaturated boss
Target equipment / priorities: Staff. INT, magic accuracy, MP and cast reliability.
HUD / resource design: Cast commitment, personal recovery and server-reported target saturation.
Specific regression: Resolve two same-tick impacts on one boss: exactly one full bonus, one reduced. Repeat on separate bosses, resist to zero, despawn and respawn. Helix, non-Astro magic and normal burst damage are unaffected.
Lore basis: elemental magic, Dark Magic and long spell commitments

Party / encounter niche: One ally whose cast time or MP is limiting
Target equipment / priorities: Staff or club. MP, survivability and positioning.
HUD / resource design: Recipient, valid range, channel remaining and eligible cast.
Specific regression: Pair with healer and nuker separately. Interrupt link before ally starts. Confirm one cast, no instant grant and no acceleration of Astromancer.
Lore basis: elemental magic, Dark Magic and long spell commitments

Party / encounter niche: One slot must alternate between a proxy tank and caster pet
Target equipment / priorities: Scythe. HP and pet survival in tank mode, INT, accuracy and MP in caster mode.
HUD / resource design: Thrall form, role, HP, active order
Specific regression: Switch forms during controlled pulls. Compare enmity recipient and spell pressure, then kill or dismiss the thrall and check tier restoration.
Lore basis: elemental magic, Dark Magic and long spell commitments

Party / encounter niche: A boss susceptible to several different enfeebles
Target equipment / priorities: Sword, empty sub. Enhancing skill, magic accuracy, parry, HP and MP.
HUD / resource design: Enfeeble count, ward remaining and Flow
Specific regression: Measure at 0, 1 and 5 distinct enfeebles. A resisted cast contributes zero. Spend one Flow and check its cost on recast.

Party / encounter niche: A mixed party needing different individual buffs mid-fight
Target equipment / priorities: Sword or dagger; magic accuracy, enhancing skill and MP.
HUD / resource design: Order type, intended ally, expiry.
Specific regression: Overwrite an Advance with Recompose before issuing. Verify a resisted or dispelled effect cannot create two full orders.

Party / encounter niche: A boss alternating melee and magic vulnerabilities
Target equipment / priorities: Sword, empty sub or shield; DEX, accuracy, INT and MAB.
HUD / resource design: Yin/Yang, switch recovery, target damage response.
Specific regression: Compare equal time in one favorable aspect vs rapid switching on an unchanged boss. Switch during an elemental cast and verify a single resolution.

Party / encounter niche: Planned physical mitigation and tight hate ordering
Target equipment / priorities: Dagger or sword, accuracy, DEX and reduced enmity.
HUD / resource design: Transfer ally/position and Attack Down ICD.
Specific regression: Test same WS hit and miss, with/without ally aligned, and with stronger Attack Down. Prototype currently tests WS use and existing status, so require hit confirmation.
Lore basis: positional attacks, evasion and manipulation of enmity

Party / encounter niche: Another party member or gear reliably exposes defense
Target equipment / priorities: Dagger or sword. DEX, crit, accuracy and attack. Optional crossbow with acid bolts for solo Defense Down; marksmanship WS never triggers the refund.
HUD / resource design: Target Defense Down, ICD and TP.
Specific regression: Test solo equipment proc and party-applied debuff, then a missed WS while debuffed. Miss gives zero refund and leaves ICD ready.
Lore basis: positional attacks, evasion and manipulation of enmity

Party / encounter niche: Fast enemy attack rounds and little unavoidable magic
Target equipment / priorities: Dagger or katana; EVA, AGI, HP and mitigation.
HUD / resource design: Dare timer, actual evades and incoming unavoidable hit guard.
Specific regression: Start with a healer pulling aggro. Confirm Dare recovers it, ordinary misses yield threat at most every 2s, and a magic-only boss produces no evade triggers.
Lore basis: positional attacks, evasion and manipulation of enmity

Party / encounter niche: Frontline triage and clustered Majesty cures
Target equipment / priorities: Club and shield. HP, MND, cure potency and shield block.
HUD / resource design: Beacon recipient, Majesty and Aegis
Specific regression: Injure two allies by different amounts. Verify Beacon chooses the intended ally and splash cures do not recursively splash.

Party / encounter niche: Exposed party members within interception range
Target equipment / priorities: Club and shield. Block, HP, enmity and mitigation.
HUD / resource design: Zeal, intercept coverage and party ward
Specific regression: Compare the same attack on an ally inside and outside intercept range. Check both HP deltas and total redirected damage.

Party / encounter niche: A predictable fight with a stable offensive or reactive assignment
Target equipment / priorities: Great sword, STR, accuracy, HP.
HUD / resource design: Oath, eligible retaliation and time left.
Specific regression: Try swapping on hate list and test a qualifying hit on an ally versus the player. Only the latter arms Absolve.

Party / encounter niche: A boss with frequent readable action completions
Target equipment / priorities: Scythe, accuracy, STR and WS damage.
HUD / resource design: Target recovery timer, six-round count and execute threshold.
Specific regression: Measure identical-HP hits before/during recovery and below threshold. Multi-hit TP moves create one window only.
Lore basis: Dark Magic, Absorb and the scythe

Party / encounter niche: Sustained physical hits from a drainable boss
Target equipment / priorities: Scythe. VIT, HP, dark skill and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Blood Tithe, overcap HP and spikes
Specific regression: Compare a living target and undead target. Let temporary overcap expire during damage and check current/max HP.
Lore basis: Dark Magic, Absorb and the scythe

Party / encounter niche: One recurring source of boss damage or healing dominates
Target equipment / priorities: Scythe or great sword. Dark magic accuracy, MP and survival.
HUD / resource design: Selected category, target, expiry and immunity fallback.
Specific regression: Alternate Ash and Withering; physical autos and scripted fixed HP transitions stay unchanged. Test hard immunity with two Scourges.
Lore basis: Dark Magic, Absorb and the scythe

Signature decision: Turn melee cadence into sonic WS
Party / encounter niche: A melee slot must keep songs up during sustained contact
Target equipment / priorities: Dagger or sword in main and offhand, instrument. CHR, accuracy and melee stats.
HUD / resource design: Cadence count and Encore time
Specific regression: Check that a qualifying WS produces one sonic follow-up and no recursive skillchain.

Party / encounter niche: Frequent allied skillchains and time to sing
Target equipment / priorities: Any legally equippable BRD main weapon and instrument. CHR, MAB and magic accuracy.
HUD / resource design: Resonance, protected songs and burst timing
Specific regression: Compare in-window and out-of-window song hits. Confirm offensive casts preserve the party's existing buff slots.

Party / encounter niche: Ranged threat while sustaining personal defensive songs
Target equipment / priorities: Any legally equippable BRD main weapon. Shield and instrument with CHR, song skill, HP and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Defensive songs, Chord and Aria
Specific regression: From zero TP acquire one boss, recover it after a large cure and check control on a sleep-immune target.

Party / encounter niche: A clear firing lane and few mandatory movements
Target equipment / priorities: Gun or crossbow, matching bullets/bolts; dagger or axe as ordinary melee sidearm. Ranged accuracy then ranged attack.
HUD / resource design: Aim progress, lane validity and ammo.
Specific regression: Count projectiles, ammo, TP and claims on successful, interrupted and missed shots. Compare a stationary boss and forced movement.

Tier or modal role: Tank / HybridSupport on main; Tank with either redesign beast
Party / encounter niche: A pet must hold hate while its fragile master directs it
Target equipment / priorities: Redesign uses one-handed axe, optional offhand dagger. Commands work without a custom horn. Accuracy, pet HP and threat. Preserve ranged gear and learned ranged WS in storage.
HUD / resource design: Pet form, pet threat, Beastguard range and Last Whistle
Specific regression: At 8y and beyond, log master damage from conal and single-target hits. Kill the pet and test recovery. Both redesign families must hold hate.

Party / encounter niche: One ally can land a specific elemental follow-up
Target equipment / priorities: Bow and arrows, dagger or axe sidearm. Ranged accuracy and magic accuracy.
HUD / resource design: Element, enemy and unclaimed mark time.
Specific regression: Resolve two matching ally hits simultaneously; apply bonus once. A wrong element, DoT or unrelated party cannot claim it.

Party / encounter niche: Large hits that leave time to clear deferred damage
Target equipment / priorities: Great katana. HP, parry, accuracy and TP gain.
HUD / resource design: Stagger amount/time, Third Eye
Specific regression: Delay purification, record direct and deferred damage, then clear it halfway. Test nonlethal ticks and real incoming damage together.

Party / encounter niche: A chain needs both archery and Tachi steps
Target equipment / priorities: Great katana, bow and arrows. Ranged and melee accuracy, Store TP.
HUD / resource design: Drawn Oisoya and Cosmic Brand
Specific regression: Repeat Tachi→Archery→Tachi and same-skill WS twice. Verify the intended refund and chain properties.

Party / encounter niche: Melee allies can exploit a closer's sustained aura
Target equipment / priorities: Great katana, accuracy, Store TP and WS gear.
HUD / resource design: Ashura's Edge, aura radius and Noto
Specific regression: Compare an actual skillchain close with the same WS fired alone. Move one party member outside aura range.

Party / encounter niche: Rebuild windows between boss area attacks
Target equipment / priorities: Katana. Accuracy, STR/DEX, attack and WS damage.
HUD / resource design: Live clone count, next expiry, Assault duration and shared target
Specific regression: Spawn 2 then 3, refresh at cap, interrupt a cast, lose a clone mid-Legion, zone during Assault. Check attribution once per landed strike and no defensive images.

Party / encounter niche: Absorbable single hits with time to restore images
Target equipment / priorities: Dual katanas, HP, ninjutsu skill and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Images, Ash and Smoke
Specific regression: Consume images with single and multi-hit attacks. Compare decoy expiry with genuine shadow-break events.

Party / encounter niche: Slow, readable enemy casts or techniques
Target equipment / priorities: Katana or dagger. Ninjutsu skill, magic accuracy and cast time.
HUD / resource design: Telegraph category, matching seal, expiry.
Specific regression: Seal a cast already canceled, an interruptible spell and a scripted immune attack. Never interrupt by repeatedly fishing mismatches.

Party / encounter niche: Melee burst after a safe approach from distance
Target equipment / priorities: Polearm, STR, accuracy and jump gear.
HUD / resource design: Run-up band, landing validity and follow-up.
Specific regression: Test wall, elevation, moving target and ordinary close melee. Count exactly one Vault hit on one enemy and no traversal of blocked geometry.
Lore basis: jump timing, polearms and the wyvern bond

Party / encounter niche: One predictable incoming technique while the tank retains hate
Target equipment / priorities: Polearm, HP, enmity and mitigation.
HUD / resource design: Guard expiry, intercepted action and landing threat.
Specific regression: With healer second on hate verify boss never turns away simply because Guard was pressed. Compare early, on-time and late activation.
Lore basis: jump timing, polearms and the wyvern bond

Party / encounter niche: Emergency spot healing with a living wyvern
Target equipment / priorities: Polearm. HP, cure potency, accuracy and wyvern survival.
HUD / resource design: Wyrmscale, wyvern HP and breath readiness
Specific regression: Create different HP deficits, use a WS and then a breath. Dismiss the wyvern and verify pet-dependent healing stops.
Lore basis: jump timing, polearms and the wyvern bond

Party / encounter niche: A prepared Blue Mage can exploit changing damage resistances
Target equipment / priorities: Sword or club. Blue skill, MP, accuracy and magic accuracy.
HUD / resource design: Set answers, assessed category and duration.
Specific regression: Two equal-resistance categories both qualify. Verify only selected target takes Soul-converted Bomb Toss damage and no Azure Surge is granted.

Signature decision: Weave Blue heals and melee waves
Party / encounter niche: Repeated group damage with opportunities to dual-wield
Target equipment / priorities: Dual sword/club. MND, cure potency, HP, fast cast and accuracy.
HUD / resource design: Azure Catalyst and Conduit time
Specific regression: Compare 4 vs 5 Catalyst and a qualifying WS. One healing spell should generate one intended splash per ally.

Signature decision: Layer Chitin and choose the next cast
Party / encounter niche: Tanking demands flexible Blue Magic responses
Target equipment / priorities: Sword or club, with Dual Wield. HP, Blue Magic, accuracy and mitigation.
HUD / resource design: Chitin and Azure Surge
Specific regression: At two and three Chitin test the defensive cast. Spend a Surge on one spell and verify the next spell again costs MP.

Party / encounter niche: A single target allows long firing uptime
Target equipment / priorities: Main gun with bullets. Owner's target uses two pistols and shared ammo. Preserve the existing owner's equipment and recovery conventions.
HUD / resource design: Current Powder Mark/Deadeye; display twin-pistol state only when its owner supplies it
Specific regression: Test the main single-gun fallback, then run the owner's acceptance for independent fire/TP, shared ammo, strip/re-equip and single-target credit. No implementation work on twin pistols in this handoff.

Party / encounter niche: Reliable party rolls plus a voluntary cooldown gamble
Target equipment / priorities: Gun with bullets or dagger; cards where applicable. HP, roll potency and TP reserve.
HUD / resource design: Roll totals, Lucky/XI, ante/debt and lock
Specific regression: Stand on 1–10, force a bust, and compare party buffs to the COR's HP/TP and debt. Check excluded cooldowns at jackpot.

Party / encounter niche: Close-range gun control and timed personal shielding
Target equipment / priorities: One-handed sword, gun, bullets, optional buckler. HP and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Grapeshot, Stoneskin and active roll
Specific regression: At one and three stacks measure shield size. Remove the gun before the sword WS and verify no pistol proc.

Party / encounter niche: A long damageable target supports MP-free group sustain
Target equipment / priorities: Dual daggers or throwing chakram. Accuracy, HP and healing output.
HUD / resource design: Finishing Moves, Veil and Samba
Specific regression: Compare one weak and one hard-hitting attack on equally injured allies. Check overheal conversion and no hostile splash.

Party / encounter niche: Melee is hazardous but Dazes and Sambas need upkeep
Target equipment / priorities: Chakram in ranged, ammo empty; dagger/sword for melee fallback. Throwing skill, accuracy and DEX.
HUD / resource design: Stance, Dazes, Finishing Moves and finisher
Specific regression: Test first throwing WS at 20y with ammo empty. Toggle stance and check correct range/cadence after losing target.

Party / encounter niche: Frequent single-target hate snaps and short interrupts
Target equipment / priorities: Dual daggers. Parry, HP, accuracy and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Finishing Moves, shield, provoke and stun recasts
Specific regression: Pull without a WAR subjob, Waltz under Fan Dance and test a parry string. Check server branch 4 across socket and search displays.

Signature decision: Heal with Light Arts and Eos
Party / encounter niche: Repeated group wounds and removable status effects
Target equipment / priorities: Dagger, club or staff. MND, MP, cure potency and fast cast. Orphic Egg is a companion option.
HUD / resource design: Eos health, Sublimation, Regen and Accession coverage
Specific regression: Cast the same single cure near two wounded allies. Verify Eos cleansing/regen and Sublimation with no HP drain.

Party / encounter niche: Long fights with forced movement and durable targets
Target equipment / priorities: Dagger, sword, club or staff. INT, MAB, magic accuracy and elemental skill. Orphic Egg supports Titania.
HUD / resource design: Titania target, Helix element/tick/expiry, Dark Arts
Specific regression: Separate Helix ticks, Titania casts and player nukes over five minutes. A second Astromancer's saturation must leave all three streams untouched.

Party / encounter niche: A known enemy repeats a specific move on a predictable victim
Target equipment / priorities: Staff or club. MP, survival and casting speed.
HUD / resource design: Enemy/action ID rendered as its visible name, record time, page owner and expiry.
Specific regression: Record two different same-element spells. Only the exact sampled action from the same enemy can consume the chosen page.

Party / encounter niche: Both can stay on one target and land actual Ready attacks
Target equipment / priorities: Axe or great axe, offensive jug and obtainable starter beast. Master and pet accuracy before attack.
HUD / resource design: Pet target/HP/TP, two eligibility timers. No extra resource meter.
Specific regression: Log master WS and actual pet action in reverse order as well. Dismiss and resummon during ICD and verify no duplicate modifier or recycled entity-ID inheritance.
Lore basis: monster ecology, jug beasts and Ready commands

Party / encounter niche: The master must hold hate while the beast shares damage
Target equipment / priorities: One-handed axe and empty sub. HP, pet HP, guard and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Guardian HP, Soul-Link and threat recipient
Specific regression: Verify a master hit splits once and pet threat accrues to the master. Remove or kill pet and verify the master takes the normal hit.
Lore basis: monster ecology, jug beasts and Ready commands

Signature decision: Read family and expose a damage type
Party / encounter niche: Physical allies can coordinate their swings to an observed weakness
Target equipment / priorities: Axe, accurate offensive pet and pet survival gear.
HUD / resource design: Family, selected type, pet delivery deadline and exposure.
Specific regression: Use a non-beast and an unknown-family boss. Compare matching and off-type hits. Keep pet on another target to verify exposure fails.
Lore basis: monster ecology, jug beasts and Ready commands

Party / encounter niche: Elemental vulnerabilities rotate between boss phases
Target equipment / priorities: Staff, summoning skill, pet magic accuracy, MP and pact damage.
HUD / resource design: Avatar/element, promise, target and remaining window.
Specific regression: Swap avatar mid-commit and send pact to a different target. Test correct and resistant elements. Check master contributes no duplicate elemental hit.

Party / encounter niche: Grouped allies need a Ward response and continuous sustain
Target equipment / priorities: Staff or club. MP, summoning skill, cure potency and avatar survival.
HUD / resource design: Avatar, sanctuary coverage and Ward recast
Specific regression: Cast Ward with an ally inside then outside Sanctuary. Confirm avatar and player recovery fire once per intended trigger.

Party / encounter niche: Several allies can follow an announced element together
Target equipment / priorities: Staff or club. Summoning skill, MP and pet survival.
HUD / resource design: Announced element, time left and named allies who have followed.
Specific regression: Have two allies hit different mobs and one ally hit twice. Verify separate claims, one per ally, and ordinary damage from the repeat.

Party / encounter niche: A controllable shield automaton must absorb the encounter
Target equipment / priorities: H2H or existing bare-fist fallback, Valoredge frame/head. Pet HP, defense and repair.
HUD / resource design: Frame, pet HP, Strobe and Bulwark
Specific regression: Transfer a target to Valoredge after a large cure. Repair during burst and retest following Retrieve and re-deploy.

Party / encounter niche: The healer needs a pet-delivered cure, cleanse or ward on demand
Target equipment / priorities: H2H and a supported healer frame. MND, repair and cure potency, pet MP.
HUD / resource design: Maneuver, Aether Cells, frame HP/MP
Specific regression: Fire the three directives separately, then Overhaul at 0 and 3 cells. Confirm only the chosen directive responds.

Party / encounter niche: A party needs deliberate master-to-frame skillchain timing
Target equipment / priorities: H2H and offensive automaton frame. Master/pet accuracy, TP and attack.
HUD / resource design: Pet TP, frame, opening and Limiter
Specific regression: Let one opening expire and consume a second with the automaton WS. Compare damage, timing and master/pet attribution.

Party / encounter niche: Great-sword uptime can prepare a personal magic burst
Target equipment / priorities: Great sword. Accuracy, STR, MAB and magic accuracy.
HUD / resource design: Runes, Conduction and Edgeflare
Specific regression: Compare Bolt/Sever at zero and full Conduction. Change element and check only the intended cast consumes the preparation.
Lore basis: rune enchantments, swordplay and elemental wards

Party / encounter niche: A frontline party needs different healing or cleanse outcomes
Skill eligibility in current WS profile: sword, great sword, axe, great axe, club
Target equipment / priorities: RUN open WS skills. Great sword preferred for melee uptime. MND, HP, cure potency and Regen.
HUD / resource design: Rune order, next Pulse result, Regen and ward
Specific regression: Repeat Pulse with two distinct combinations against the same injury/status. Measure lifetap separately from Regen.
Lore basis: rune enchantments, swordplay and elemental wards

Signature decision: Switch parry and rune ward stances
Party / encounter niche: Physical and elemental boss phases alternate
Skill eligibility in current WS profile: sword, great sword, axe, great axe, club
Target equipment / priorities: RUN open WS skills; great sword maximizes the parry benefit. HP, parry, magic evasion and enmity.
HUD / resource design: Stance, held runes and transition cooldown
Specific regression: Alternate physical and elemental hits in each stance. Check rune retention on Lunge and hate recovery at zero TP.
Lore basis: rune enchantments, swordplay and elemental wards

Party / encounter niche: The party can hold a line whose endpoints you control
Target equipment / priorities: Club or staff and handbell. HP, geomancy skill and positioning.
HUD / resource design: Endpoints, active length, remaining life and inside/outside state.
Specific regression: Move past both ends, across the edge and onto another floor. No bonus beyond the segment ends plus the allowed width or across floors.

Party / encounter niche: A group can stand within a healing sanctuary
Target equipment / priorities: Club/shield or staff, handbell. MND, geomancy, MP and pet durability.
HUD / resource design: Luopan HP, bloom radius and Canopy
Specific regression: Move an ally out of range, heal with a nearly full luopan, then dismiss it. Check the surge and overheal shield independently.

Party / encounter niche: The boss will stay still for a delayed single-target detonation
Target equipment / priorities: Staff or club and handbell. INT, MAB, magic accuracy.
HUD / resource design: Fixed position, locked enemy, radius, fuse and hit/miss.
Specific regression: Put a second mob on the marker and move the claimed target away. Neither mob should take damage. Repeat with the original target stationary.
